name: Gong
bestFor: AI-analyzed call and email intelligence that tells revenue leaders what's really happening in deals
description: A revenue intelligence platform that records and analyzes sales calls, emails, and deal activity with AI, surfacing coaching insights, deal risk, and forecast signals for sales leaders.

freeTier.limits: No free tier; sales-led onboarding for all customers

paidTier.notes: Gong does not publish list pricing. Market-reported data puts Foundations around $1,300–$1,600/user/year, plus a mandatory platform fee of roughly $5,000–$50,000/year and a $7,500+ onboarding fee — reported figures, not an official price list. Confirm directly with Gong.

name: Apollo.io
bestFor: AI-assisted prospecting, enrichment, and outbound sequencing with an actually usable free plan
description: A sales intelligence and engagement platform combining a large B2B contact database with AI email writing, call analysis, and multichannel outbound sequences.

freeTier.limits: 50 data credits/month, company & people search, limited sequences

paidTier.notes: Basic $49/user/month (annual, 5,000 credits/year); Professional $79/user/month (AI email writing, dialer); Organization $119/user/month (custom reports, 200 mobile credits/month).
